title: Louisiana Starlink companion recheck preserves the September 1 evidence decision
summary: Seventeen current official surfaces fix the 10,635-location planning cohort but supply no compatible observed installation, subscription, or service-taken return, so the signal remains In Review under a bounded No Material Change companion receipt.
evidence_note: This receipt is bounded to the official public surfaces reviewed on September 8. It does not establish that a qualifying artifact does not exist, that no eligible location installed or subscribed, or that the program succeeded or failed. The ConnectLA planning files identify exactly 10,635 unique location IDs, but planned coverage, offer terms, availability, authorization, and provider-wide totals cannot substitute for an observed fixed-cohort outcome.
publication_effect: Adds an append-only companion receipt and current source context while preserving the September 1 cycle decision, the three-of-thirteen completed-decision count, the signal's In Review state, and the absence of a matching Phase 61 file. Git-backed release remains Held.
